integrity: Exact finite discrete-Morse certificate with full directed Hasse acyclicity and independent mod-two boundary computation is included. The classification is integral homotopy, not inferred from field homology. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the two explicitly named sixteen-vertex graphs. The rook complex had a previously published homotopy classification; only the Shrikhande classification and its comparison are asserted as new. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible; no independent audit has occurred.
title: Triangle-avoidance homotopy distinguishes the Shrikhande and rook graphs
